parts: Our litters are selective and sporadic.
Dogs that we used to raise have a degree of hip dysplasia of A-A and bitches between A and B (HD free)
All the OES have official x-rays done by an official veterinarian accredited by AVEPA, CEPPA and CEPB.
Our puppies are wormed, vaccinated and identified with microchip.
They are bred in a familiar atmosphere to guarantee their character.

- your experience in Bobtail (or other breed) and your possible prefix.
